provenance: git archive of the production fix's parent exported into ignored workspace scratch. PYTHONPATH selected its actual source; a separate import printed the exported state_manager.py path. Exported state_manager blob matched git rev-parse parent:path; both test files had the same blob.
Tar exited 1 after filesystem denials for two unrelated files (.vscode/settings.json and vendored .gitmodules). Required Python source, tests and config were extracted.

The shipped surface-memories-on-turn-start rule runs through real RuleEngine and _RuleLoopBridge.call for native UserPromptSubmit. Real SessionVariableManager reads an isolated PostgreSQL session/defaults store. Only the memory dispatcher is faked; it performs the real scoped read before a controlled timer completes recall.

Definition cache warmup, large-state writes and engine construction precede timing. The fix filters defaults before deepcopy; the parent copies all defaults before selecting keys. No bridge delay, replacement state manager, production logging, wake staggering or live capture.

This is a defect: unrelated default size multiplies work for a two-key read even for one prompt with no wake fanout. Parent exceeds 1s; fixed meets 1s. Scoped-read time overlaps hook time; do not sum them. Remaining parent hook time is not separately attributed.

Natural samples locate dominant measured work inside memory surfacing. Attribution to state-variable reads rests on retained samples plus this reproduction under amended criterion3; these numbers are not a matched live-fleet improvement estimate.
